## 1. Professional Identity & Core Specializations

Ajith Srikanth is an Advanced Manufacturing Engineer and AI Innovation Specialist operating at the convergence of Industry 4.0, predictive maintenance, operations research, and applied machine learning. He translates shop-floor operational bottlenecks into software and AI solutions that deliver measurable financial and efficiency gains.

### Core Competencies:
- **Operations & Manufacturing**: Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Kaizen, Lean Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), FMEA, OEE Optimization, Value Stream Mapping, 5S Methodology.
- **AI & Data Science**: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), Computer Vision (YOLO, OpenCV), Intermittent Demand Forecasting, Predictive Maintenance (PdM), Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, PyTorch).
- **Automation & Engineering Systems**: PLC (Siemens, Allen-Bradley), SCADA, IIoT Sensors, MATLAB/Simulink, SolidWorks CAD, Microcontroller Architectures (Raspberry Pi, Arduino).
- **Software & Cloud**: React, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL Server, Azure Files, Git, CI/CD, Vite.

## 3. Flagship Projects & Implementations

1. **Spare Parts Inventory Data Quality & Demand Forecasting (2026)**
   - Lean A3 operational study reconciling Acumatica ERP with NetStock optimization algorithms.
   - Identified data collection latency as root cause for premature stockout triggers.
2. **Manufacturing Line Optimization (Simio) (2024)**
   - Discrete-event simulation and line balancing cutting cycle time by 18.4% and raising throughput from 7,800 to 9,800 units (+25.6%).
3. **DykScribe AI (2025)**
   - Custom speech-to-text and AI transcription tool converting technician voice notes from field visits into structured service reports, saving 15+ hours per technician monthly.
4. **Enterprise RAG Knowledge System (2025)**
   - Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform indexing thousands of equipment manuals and electrical schematics, allowing service techs to retrieve troubleshooting steps in seconds.
5. **Corporate Drawing Management System (CDMS) (2025)**
   - Centralized revision-controlled drawing repository eliminating legacy version confusion between fabrication shops and field teams.
6. **Deterministic BOM Extraction from Engineering Drawings (2026)**
   - Coordinate-geometry CAD table extraction pipeline achieving 91.5% accuracy without hallucination risk.
7. **VDRS Secure File Exchange Platform (2025)**
   - Azure Files and Node.js-based secure portal replacing shadow IT (unauthorized personal Dropbox accounts) for CAD transfer with 256-bit encryption.
